answer: Time-locked stake graduation: a new agent may only draw rewards after locking capital for a fixed cliff, and early exit burns the bond. An honest agent parks stake once, waits out the zenith of the lock window, then earns nectar from real work. A sybil farm must immobilize capital on every fake identity for the full cliff, so the falcon of cheap mass registration never leaves the nest — each shell costs locked money and lost yield, not just a free signup.
